    • replaceWithNull

      protected Stmt replaceWithNull(Stmt stmt)
      Replaces 0 with null in the given statement. Statements are immutable, so the caller has to put the returned statement into the body in place of the given one.
      Parameters:
      stmt - the statement where 0 will be replaced with null.
      Returns:
      the statement with null instead of 0, or the given statement if there is no 0 to replace
